verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API and MCP server cover a wide range of UI actions—feedback CRUD, teams, features/initiatives, custom fields, webhooks, analytics—suggesting broad but not confirmed-complete parity with the UI. There's no evidence of a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s) or explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, and some UI-only features (e.g., automatic insight detection, roadmap visualization, strategic alignment views) aren't shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, OpenAPI/schema discoverability, and independent confirmation that all UI workflows are API-reachable.
